notes: Visible gear (paper doll), PC. Looks only: which art strip a worn part draws. Keyed by the mobile gear part ids (backend/gear_bag.gd on origin/mobile: '<family>.<slot>'). Stats, drops and inventory live elsewhere. A class with 'enabled' draws its unarmoured base split by slot; every slot that has a worn look draws that look instead of the base strip of the slot. Strips are stacked in 'stack' order per art facing (S front, E back; W and N mirror them); every strip also has an optional '_back' part drawn first (pieces behind the body: the far arm in S). A worn part '<family>.<slot>' of a set listed in 'sets' (same class) draws the strip '<family>_<slot>' when the build made it (units/pc_gear_specs.gd STRIPS); a part with no strip draws nothing and the base shows.
